payload.text: ST0093/06 (c) to (e) are drafted on vc's word in tmp/wt-dc-0093-06 off main, and banked unproved at refs/bank/dc/0093-06/cde-draft-unproved-v3-on-fdd9fa2df. Nothing is run and nothing is written to Devbin's tree. The proof run waits until devbin-vc's sweep of devbin 0.1.23 lands in Intent and vc sends dc its commit. Then dc rebases the draft onto it and makes one proof run for the batch. After the run, dc writes 0682's Resolution and closes it in the bank (after, because canon's clean-estate test reads intent/.canon/issues against HEAD), re-banks, and vc lands it. The draft covers three parts. (c) is a build: block declaring the pair, with its handlers calling cache get and put (0338). (d) points rust's gate target at DEVBIN_GATE_CACHE (0335). (e) moves tests/run_tests.sh onto the core's lanes runner (0339), whose parallel lane runs 24 tests at once by default from 0.1.23 (0340). Two units that cannot share a host are tagged serial: release_gate_script.bats as a file, and docs_completeness.bats's agents sync test (both at refs/bank/dc/0093-06/e-serial-unproved-v2-on-fdd9fa2df). (a) and (b) landed at 6375023ea.
